author: CC
revisit: Akien, 2026-08-11: 'well, in a month we can revisit.' That lands on 2026-09-11. Said in answer to this measurement and the /summarize idea it hangs off — he did not narrow which of the two he meant, and it is recorded unnarrowed rather than guessed. NOTHING FIRES THIS. It is a date in a file, which is the same shape as the problem being measured here; if the month passes unremarked, that is itself the datum.
text: MEASURED: /moreabout has fired TWICE, EVER — both on 2026-07-28, the day it was built, and never again in the fourteen days since. The two asks are 'what did the tree-stratum orientation packet actually scope in and out?' (chart_orient_nodes) and 'why must a scan measure the capability itself instead of grepping for the word?' (orient_corrections_nodes). Counted by kind='moreabout_signal' across every nexus table; 2 signals against 704 nodes total. Akien had put the doubt on it himself in one aside — 'at least, it's supposed to be!' — and the number is worse than the doubt. THE DOOR IS NOT BROKEN. It works, it is tenant-generic, its signal rides inside the one command so it cannot be skipped when the honest datum is unflattering. What it lacks is a reason to be reached for: nothing fires it, and a thing nobody calls learns nothing regardless of how good its learning path is. WHY THIS MATTERS TO THE /summarize IDEA IT HANGS OFF: that skill is proposed with the same firing model — called by hand, by either party, with no crossing to gate it, because (Akien) 'debug doesn't lend itself.' So 2-firings-in-14-days is the DEFAULT OUTCOME it has to beat, not a risk to note. The third data point agrees: /challenge fired 3 times in 10 as an optional route and had to be moved inside /intent's packet to fire at all. THE ONE PART OF THE PROPOSAL THAT ATTACKS THIS is the fourth clause, 'a reminder to update it if it wasn't adiquate' — a payoff loop rather than a gate: make the answer better every time it disappoints, so the reaching becomes worth it. That is the load-bearing clause, and on this evidence it is the whole design rather than a finishing touch.
